notablePrerequisites:
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
You control at least one basic land.
description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pili-Pala, untapping the basic land.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it for Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.
